join_order.notes: Single pass over cn.country_code.bin to set bits where == us_code; ~29 KB bitset fits L1.
For each writer ci row, walk mc range for ci.movie_id; check any mc.company_id is_us bit set. Short-circuit on first hit.
Existence test (hi>lo) since n1.id is dense-PK identity; n1 join collapses to bounds check pid in [1, 4167491].

data_structures.is_us_company: std::vector<uint8_t> bitset sized to company_name row count (234997)
data_structures.min_aggregation: per-thread {best_title_row, best_aka_name_row} indices; final lexicographic compare via off/dat slices

parallelism.notes: Split [lo,hi) of csr rowids for rt_id_writer into equal chunks; each thread maintains a local min (row index into title and into aka_name range). Reduce by lexicographic comparison of varlen strings using title.off/dat and aka_name.off/dat at finalize.

writer_pseudo_name.candidate_rows: any ak row in [akpid_off[pid], akpid_off[pid+1]) for qualifying ci rows
writer_pseudo_name.strategy: track current best row id; compare candidate string_view < current best string_view; update if smaller

movie_title.strategy: track current best row id; lexicographic compare and update

min_aggregate_details.reduction: merge per-thread bests by string compare

execution_notes: Per writer ci row r: pid=ci.person_id[r]; mv=ci.movie_id[r].
Existence on aka_name: if akpid_off[pid+1] <= akpid_off[pid], skip.
Existence on movie US company: scan mc rows in [mcmid_off[mv], mcmid_off[mv+1]); any company_id where is_us_company[company_id-1] set qualifies; break on first hit.
If qualifies, update local MIN(title at row mv-1) and iterate aka_name range [akpid_off[pid], akpid_off[pid+1]) updating local MIN(name).
n1 join is degenerate: name.id is identity dense-PK; n1.id = ci.person_id = a1.person_id is implied; no probe needed beyond bounds.
Avoid materializing intermediate result set; streaming min only.
